ELKID-EL_KID.title: El Kid
ELKID-EL_KID.description:
A young duelist who fights between the ticks of the clock.
Bank [aqua]Time[/aqua] when you're Slow, then spend it Fast.
ELKID-EL_KID.goldMonologue: [sine]Could buy a lot of time with this...[/sine]
ELKID-EL_KID.eventDeathPrevention: Not yet. The clock's still ticking.
ELKID-EL_KID.aromaPrinciple: [sine][aqua]Faster than the blink of an eye.[/aqua][/sine]
ELKID-EL_KID.cardsModifierDescription: El Kid cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
